Ben / Maya —

Appreciate the detail. We ran a quick pass and attached a first-draft topology and bill-of-materials. Key clarifications:

1) Bridging: we can provision a primary Zoom Rooms bridge on our hosted bridge with 8 concurrent H.264 inbound/4 outbound PSTN lines for overflow. Backup Webex can be held in warm stand-by with instant join links. Fallback logic will be handled at the MCU layer.

2) Cameras: two PTZs (near podium), one wide field for the audience, and a roving gimbal for close-ups. All camera feeds will be iso-recorded to the onboard NVR and pushed to the RTMP endpoint.

3) Audio: four Sennheiser wireless lavs, two ceiling capsules for audience, and a Dante-enabled house snake to connect to the venue console.

4) Network: we recommend a dedicated event VLAN (we’ll bring our own router for NAT and QoS). If venue can guarantee 150 Mbps up on VLAN, we’ll use that; otherwise we’ll bring a bonded LTE fallback (adds ~10–15s failover time).

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you confirm the RTMP ingest endpoint and whether captions will be generated at source or via a cloud provider?
- Do you want the backup bridge to host captions as well?

Attachments: stellarav-topology-v1.pdf, bom-stellarav-v1.csv

—
